negotiations.message: We need 400 KG of fresh tomatoes. Can you lower the price to 62 NRs/KG?
Since transport from Dhading to Kathmandu is high, let's meet in the middle at 68 NRs/KG. Hand-sorted organic quality.

soilLogs.details: Soil test results: pH 6.4, Nitrogen: Moderate, Phosphorus: Low, Potassium: High. Recommended: Apply phosphate fertilizer or organic bone meal.
Applied 25kg of organic compost and bone meal to boost phosphorus levels.

cooperativeAnnouncements.title: Kalimati Tomato Price Peak Alert
cooperativeAnnouncements.content: Due to high post-monsoon demand, tomato wholesale rates at Kalimati are holding above NRs. 75/KG. Farmers with active tomato yields are advised to harvest and package immediately for bulk transport scheduled this Wednesday.

cooperativeAnnouncements.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Protect Seedlings
cooperativeAnnouncements.content: Department of Meteorology reports unexpected western disturbances bringing localized thunderstorms in Dhading. Protect vulnerable nurseries using polytunnels or plastic mulches.

cooperativeAnnouncements.title: Organic IPM Pest Control Workshop
cooperativeAnnouncements.content: Learn advanced bio-rational pest management techniques. Free workshop on organic pesticide preparation using local herbs at the cooperative warehouse this Friday at 10 AM.

platformFeedback.title: Offline SMS / USSD crop price query integration
platformFeedback.description: In remote pockets of Dhading where internet coverage is intermittent during monsoon rains, allowing farmers to send an SMS like 'PRICE TOMATO' to get instant Kalimati rates would be extremely helpful.
platformFeedback.adminNotes: Evaluating gateway partnership with Ncell/NTC for shortcode SMS dispatch.

platformFeedback.title: Bulk export order receipts to PDF or CSV
platformFeedback.description: Would love a single button on the Buyer Dashboard to export completed supply-chain order receipts for tax accounting and monthly procurement reports.
platformFeedback.adminNotes: Client-side CSV exporter in design stage.

platformFeedback.title: Mobile button size on small screen phones
platformFeedback.description: When viewing the market prices table on smaller smartphone screens, the filter dropdowns overlap slightly with the district selector.
platformFeedback.adminNotes: Fixed responsive grid padding and mobile overflow handling.
